rationale.quality: Q20 is the documented Trim Galore quality cutoff, explicitly selected for this ChIP analysis rather than inherited from RNA-seq.
rationale.length: 25 bp is a project preprocessing floor to limit very short retained genomic reads without imposing a fixed crop; it is not a claim of unique mappability.
rationale.adapters: Select a supported adapter per library and preserve the tool report; do not infer a universal adapter from instrument model. PRJNA1090249 ChIPmentation motivates checking Nextera/tagmentation sequence, not forcing it onto every input.
rationale.review: These are prospective analysis choices, not a reconstruction of every publication's preprocessing. Persistent artifacts require review before accepting peaks; do not tune against peak counts or FRiP.
